policy: These GUI recordings and the index benchmark were made with the listed earlier build and are not re-recorded for alpha.16. alpha.16 changed the GUI (language switch, keyboard access, preview, allocation scope); those changes have their own alpha.16 recordings (gui-preview, gui-allocation, gui-i18n, gui-job, gui-keyboard, gui-naming, gui-source). Every CLI/MCP suite was re-run on all four native VMs for alpha.16. The carried screens show the alpha.15 version label.
